articles.summary: NORWALK, Conn., May 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FactSet (NYSE: FDS | NASDAQ: FDS), a global financial digital platform and enterprise solutions provider, today announced that its Board of Directors approved an increase in the regular quarterly cash dividend to $1.16 per share from $1.10 per share.
